rationale: Two residual protected commerce tax SQL updates were removed from the shared module and placed behind an authenticated QA-only canonical owner command. The owner independently retrieves Stripe Tax transaction/reversal objects from Stripe's official GET /v1/tax/transactions/{id} endpoint using its own TEST secret. It validates receipt ID, type, live/test mode, currency, order/reference, metadata and original transaction on refund reversal, then performs a scope-guarded idempotent canonical D1 update. Caller cannot choose a SQL statement or bypass owner verification. Full-source SHA of commerce.server.ts is attested; the shared module has zero remaining protected SQL statements. Production owner activation, independent Stripe live and customer authorization certification and rollback remain blocked.

files.review: Two exact direct Stripe Tax write sites retired; zero canonical protected SQL now remains in the shared commerce module.
